name: Blk Dot Coffee
tagline: Famous slow-drip Vietnamese coffee (VTM), specialty lattes, and artisan breakfast bites
description: Located just one block west of The Circle on Chapman Avenue, Blk Dot Coffee brings its celebrated slow-drip Vietnamese craft coffee (the iconic 'VTM®') to the heart of Old Towne Orange. Known for its intense, velvety dark roast paired with house-made condensed milk, signature Einspänners, sea salt cold creams, and scratch breakfast eats like the Ultimate Brekkie Bowl and BEC sandwich, Blk Dot provides a sleek, modern cafe sanctuary with indoor seating and rare dedicated parking near Chapman University.
historicNote: Situated in a vintage 1930s commercial structure along historic West Chapman Avenue, conveniently featuring rare dedicated on-site parking in the bustling Old Towne district.

specials.title: Monday Morning VTM Boost
